children: Micron Technology (MU) drew attention Wednesday after Citi raised its forecasts for the memory-chip maker, citing firmer pricing in the DRAM market, according to a client note.

Citi retained its Buy rating and increased its price target to $1,300 from $1,150. Malik expects memory markets to stay undersupplied for some time, although pricing growth may moderate across the next four quarters.

Citi analyst Atif Malik now expects fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $51 billion and EPS of $31.45, edging above consensus estimates of $50.8 billion and $31.43. For fiscal first-quarter 2027, he projects $57 billion in revenue and $35.25 in EPS.

The bank also lifted its assumptions for NAND and DRAM prices, with AI-related demand supporting memory consumption while supplies remain tight. Malik expects Micron's bit shipments to broadly track industry growth in 2026 and estimates fiscal 2027 capital spending at $50 billion.
He sees prices potentially reaching a peak in the second quarter of 2027. That outlook underpins Citi's revised near-term earnings estimates and valuation.

title: Citi Revamps Micron Stock Price Target For 2027
